_note: When the scraper looks at what. Hours are local time in 'timezone'. Discovery finds new posts and refreshes the newest 'resultsPerProfile' of each account. Profiles = follower counts (Instagram and Facebook; TikTok's come with every discovery). Refresh tiers: how often a post is re-checked by age in days; daily and slower tiers run at 'anchorHourLocal' so day-to-day numbers compare like for like. crawlDepthCap: Instagram and Facebook posts are refreshed by re-crawling the profile newest-first, at most this deep (older Instagram posts fall back to by-URL scrapers). Surge: a post whose daily views beat 'deltaMultiple' x its account's median is checked every 'promoteEveryHours' for 'durationHours'.
